reconstruction_method: 4-bucket coarse time-of-day conditioning (night/morning/afternoon/evening) with global shrinkage and bias correction. Selected based on feasibility analysis in notebooks/02_entsoe_feasibility.ipynb.
window_justification: Wb=40 bucket-specific observations; Wg=672 global observations (7 days of quarter-hourly data). Chosen to balance local adaptivity with estimation stability.
